integrity: Exact all-size combinatorial proof; independent exhaustive labelled-state and particle-state verification for stated finite ranges. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only directed one-neighbour, three-state, synchronous cyclic automata on finite rings; uniform product measure for probability limits. Other neighbourhoods and nonuniform inputs unstudied. Full text of Belitsky–Ferrari 1995 unavailable for priority comparison; historical novelty qualified. Earlier 1990 literature exists but first day-resolved publicly posted anchor source dates to 1993-03-22. The particle reduction matches Kůrka–Formenti–Dennunzio (2011/12) exactly and is prior work; their infinite-lattice site-entry theorem is distinguished from this finite-ring global first-periodic-entry census.
title: Motzkin last-entry law and winding-selected basins in a directed three-colour cyclic automaton
